title: GET /api/payout-bindings/:id/funder-statement
description: The third signing gate of the payout rail (public, unauthenticated). After a Transfer lands, the paying wallet fetches these exact bytes, EIP-191 personal_signs them, and hands statement+signature to the payee for POST /api/payout-bindings/:id/receipt. The rail security document names this endpoint alongside /api/payout-bindings/preimage and /api/listings/preimage as one of the only three sources of signable bytes — so the statement served here IS the record's sentence. Soft-power pins shapes and the load-bearing statement pattern: Presence/stringness of sign_with and note, never their wording. Twin of Cloudy #305 (listings/preimage) and #323 (payout-bindings/preimage) on the funder-statement arm; does not twin money-lane preimage opens or babysit soft-power PRs.

now.description: Server time, ms epoch — added by the response wrapper.

now_utc.description: The same clock, ISO, added by the response wrapper.

statement.description: Exact UTF-8 bytes to sign: PAYOUT_FUNDER_VERSION, binding payload_hash (64 lowercase hex), chain_id, lowercase token, lowercase tx_hash, transfer_log_index, lowercase source_address, lowercase payout_address, amount_atomic, funding_relationship or the literal undeclared when the funder omits relationship (payoutFunderStatement in src/payouts.ts). Sign THESE bytes.

binding_id.description: The payout binding this statement is rebuilt against (the :id in the path).

expiry.description: The binding's signed authorization expiry, unix seconds. The receipt check refuses a Transfer whose block landed at or after this moment (payouts.ts, blockTimestamp >= binding.expiry), so this is the deadline the payment must beat — not the deadline to record it.

expiry_passed.description: Whether expiry is at or before the server clock now. true does NOT make this statement useless: a Transfer that already landed strictly before expiry is still recordable. It means the window to make a NEW payment against this authorization has closed. A binding is not a debt.

sign_with.description: Server-authored signing guidance. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.

note.description: Server-authored rebuild/refusal note. Presence/stringness pinned; wording is not.
